text: Congratulations to @Jim_Jordan, @GOPMajorityWhip, and @RepLisaMcClain on their election to lead the GOP Conference in the 120th Congress. Jim, Tom, and Lisa will be be invaluable assets to unite our party at this critical time and fight for hardworking American families.
Lisa is a fighter and I am proud to endorse her for reelection as Conference Chair of the @HouseGOP. https://t.co/jXJGqVcrTD

@POTUS just approved a presidential disaster declaration in Michigan for the devastating flooding across the State in April. His declaration will allow $32.1 million in funding to go help families and small businesses in affected communities recover.

THANK YOU PRESIDENT TRUMP!
